data.gender_notes: Muturi is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Kikuyu language, Muturi means 'friend' or 'companion'. In the context of Christian spirituality, this name can symbolize the faithful companionship of God. The name Muturi carries the meaning “Friend or companion” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Muturi usually hope their child will grow to embody friend or companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Muturi belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend or companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muturi total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
